bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; allowing students to complete state assessments remotely; appropriating money; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.30, subdivision 11, by adding subdivisions.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.30, subdivision 11, is amended to read:

Subd. 11.
Testing process.
(a) The commissioner must determine the testing process and the order of administration.
(b) The commissioner must establish a testing period as late as possible each school year during which schools must administer the Minnesota Comprehensive Assessments to students. The commissioner must publish the testing schedule at least two years before the beginning of the testing period.

(c) The commissioner must review and update assessment administration and security policies as necessary to maintain the integrity of state assessments.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.30, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 18.

Remote assessment administration.

(a) The commissioner must adopt policies and procedures necessary to administer state assessments remotely to a student enrolled in an online instructional site under section 124D.094, subdivision 1. Starting in the 2026-2027 school year, the department must allow a student enrolled in an online instructional site to participate in state assessments remotely.

(b) The remote assessment policies and procedures must include:

(1) testing personnel qualifications;

(2) a maximum ratio of students to remote proctor;

(3) testing verification;

(4) remote setting requirements, including any restrictions related to technology or Internet access;

(5) monitoring of the student and the testing environment during the test administration;

(6) device and networking requirements; and

(7) parental consent agreements.

(c) The remote assessment policies and procedures must support the validation activities necessary to administer state assessments remotely. To establish the validity of remotely administered state assessments, the department must conduct validation activities, gather data, and evaluate the comparability of scores between remotely administered state assessments and state assessments administered in person at a school site. To encourage student and educator participation in validation activities, the department may provide incentives.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.

Sec. 3.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.30, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 19.

Assessment validation.

As used in this section, "validation activities" means the process of collecting evidence to evaluate the appropriateness of the interpretations of, uses for, and decisions made based on state assessment results.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.

Sec. 4. APPROPRIATIONS; REMOTE ASSESSMENTS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal years designated.

Remote assessment administration.
